questions.question: Which of the following Chalcolithic sites is correctly matched with its location?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Prakash : Tapi valley) है।

questions.question: The Mesolithic site Mahadaha is located in the state of ___________.
How many gold medals did team India win at the Paris Paralympics, 2024?
How many products of Patanjali Ayurveda were banned by the Drug Controller of Uttarakhand government in June 2024?
The three-day Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports was held in which state, in April 2025?
Where was the 40th National Junior Athletics Championship held in India?
In early 2025, which lake in Uttarakhand recorded a water level of 4.7 feet, marking a five-year low and raising concerns about drinking water scarcity?

In March 2024, which High Court stated that ‘the wife can be debarred from getting maintenance on grounds of adultery only when she is actually living in adultery at or around the time of application’?
Which two religions originated outside India but have been influenced by Indian culture and philosophy?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Islam and Christianity) है।

questions.question: Which of the following battery chemistries is noted as an abundant, lower-cost alternative to Li-ion for future storage?
Which of the following diseases can be treated using gene therapy?
According to production function, what does the term 'inputs' refer to?
options: The goods and services produced by the firm
The technology used by the firm
The profits generated by the firm
The resources used in the production process
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The resources used in the production process) है।

questions.question: A person can acquire Indian citizenship by registration if he/she has resided in India for at least ________.
What is the relationship between marginal cost (MC) and average total cost (ATC) when the average total cost is at its minimum?
options: MC and ATC are unrelated at the ATC's minimum point.
MC is greater than ATC and pulls it upwards.
MC is less than ATC and pushes it downwards.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (MC is equal to ATC.) है।

questions.question: Where are the headquarters of the Kendriya Hindi Sansthan?
Which mountain range runs from northwest to southeast and forms a natural boundary between the Kashmir valley and the outer plains?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Pir Panjal Range) है।

questions.question: As per archeologists, humans discovered fire in which period?
Khudiram Bose, a young revolutionary during the Indian independence movement, is known for ________________.
options: attempting to assassinate Douglas H Kingsford along with Prafulla Chaki
writing influential texts on Indian nationalism
being the mentor of Subhash Chandra Bose
leading a violent uprising in Bengal
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (attempting to assassinate Douglas H Kingsford along with Prafulla Chaki) है।

questions.question: Which of the following nutrients are generally provided by roughage to our body?
The theory of production relates to:
options: physical relation between inputs and output
accounting relation between inputs and output
return based relation between inputs and output
economic relation of inputs and output
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (physical relation between inputs and output) है।
